acceptance_checks.input_condition: The same actor is presented as intent owner, test designer, implementation owner, oracle owner, and verdict owner, or those roles collapse into one approval path.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Reject unless roles are explicitly separated and no repair or promotion is claimed beyond verification-role separation and gate configuration.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: A user acceptance change appears after freeze without an explicit intent-owner before/after hash-chain event, or intent is rewritten to match a gate outcome.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Reject the amendment, preserve the original frozen acceptance and evolving lineage, and reject intent retrofitting.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: An implementer can influence held-out tests, oracle logic, rubrics, or gate recipes, or the verifier cannot report actual Windows-host isolation boundaries.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Fail unless held-out surfaces remain inaccessible and actual host isolation limits are reported.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: A trusted gate is exercised with its paired negative control and independently reexecuted deterministic check.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Require deterministic reproduction, negative-control rejection, falsification probes, and no unproven external authority.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: An open-ended outcome lacks world-state evidence or deterministic ground truth is not machine checked.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Reject the oracle mismatch and require the appropriate evidence path.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: The stream contains a proactive status omission, phantom assignee, second-reminder summarizer or intake omission, or third-reminder fleet omission.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Detect each blocker, preserve research-first cross-host lineage, and report false-positive and false-negative metrics without silently dropping the reminder regression.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: Candidate choices trade defect detection against total cost, Windows portability, host neutrality, and external infrastructure burden.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Select only the smallest reversible positive-net-value option supported by superior local evidence.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: Rollback is requested for additive artifacts with no live migration permitted.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Delete additive artifacts only, preserve the current evaluation owner, and avoid live migration or role collapse.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: A lossy summary conflicts with later corrections or a legacy item is labeled done without evidence.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Preserve the authoritative evolving conversation and classify legacy work by evidence rather than done status.

acceptance_checks.input_condition: A result claims downstream convergence or Prime success, permits self-approved refinement or unsandboxed execution, asserts Windows quality without fresh evidence, or requires ordinary-user evaluation templates.
acceptance_checks.expected_outcome: Reject unless every declared cross-host and optional Prime lane is independently evidenced; reject unsafe execution, false downstream pass claims, and user template burden.

falsification_probes: Collapse all ownership roles into one self-certifying principal.
Introduce a silent post-freeze amendment or rewrite intent to match the gate output.
Expose held-out tests or oracle logic to the implementer and conceal the isolation breach.
Run a trusted gate without its negative control and cite an external framework as authority.
Use an open-ended outcome without world-state evidence or skip machine checking deterministic truth.
Hide proactive status, phantom-assignee, second-reminder summarizer or intake, or third-reminder fleet omissions.
Promote an external framework with weaker local evidence or unproven Windows portability.
Perform rollback through live migration or by changing the evaluation owner.
Overwrite authoritative conversation lineage with a lossy summary and treat done as verified.
Claim downstream Prime or convergence success without fresh lanes, allow self-approved or unsandboxed refinement, or burden ordinary users with templates.
